document_before.title: Atlas: INC-001 incident report
document_before.text: Atlas incident INC-001 began on 2026-03-03 at 09:05 UTC. The affected service was payments-gateway; customer payments were delayed for 17 minutes. Operators observed database connection failures immediately after change CHG-001. The incident report records correlation only; the cause was confirmed in a later verification note.
